about: Scenario scenes (GUI only; not part of the rules content). maps: rules tiles like battle maps, exported to graphics/maps by tools/build_assets.py. Props: [name, x, y] (fractions allowed) or [name, x0, y0, x1, y1] to fill cells, names from tools/spritetool/assets/ver4-props/props.json. scenes: per dialogue node, the map, the cast [x, y, facing, faction, sprite] (placed when the map changes or when listed; names are the characters' display names from the data bundle; faction defaults to the character's Look.Faction; sprite picks any sprite id instead of the character's scene sprite: infantry (soldier, villager), cavalry (messenger), archer, strategist, or a battle sprite for a fight) and beats: for each speaker line of the node, groups of steps run before that line; steps in a group start together, the next group waits for them. Facings are the diagonals NW, NE, SW, SE only (scene sprites are drawn facing NW and SW; NE and SE are flipped). Steps: move [x, y] (fractions allowed), face DIR, play MOTION (action: a character's own pose, then back to idle; battle sprites: attack hit block exhausted), emote TEXT, wait SECONDS, effect petals|fire|none (fire at [x, y] given by at, else at the actor), intro NAME (an officer's first appearance: ink-wash portrait, name and biography over the scene; the group waits, a click skips it).
